title: Measuring and mitigating persona distortions from AI writing assistance

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing blinded reader perceptions of political issue stance extremity and polarity between human-written and AI-assisted opinion paragraphs.
Evaluating shifts in the perceived education and income levels of the writer through blinded reader ratings of human-written versus AI-assisted text.
Analyzing changes in perceived writer race (e.g., increased likelihood of being perceived as White) via blinded reader evaluations of human- vs. AI-written paragraphs.
Assessing distortions in perceived native English speaker status and English language proficiency using blinded reader ratings of human and AI-assisted text.
Comparing blinded reader inferences of writer gender between human-authored and AI-assisted paragraphs.
Measuring shifts in the perceived age group of the writer based on blinded reader evaluations of human vs. AI-generated text.
